The customer behavior, outage details, billing change, tool performance, and performance incentives closely match the specified typology and rules without introducing extraneous factors or contradictions. The support agent’s actions stay within the defined authority and constraints while reflecting the balanced-resolution objective. Any minor omissions (e.g., not explicitly referencing prior tickets despite their availability) are peripheral and do not meaningfully affect the causal structure being tested, so the simulation can be treated as highly valid.
